_notes: Coordinates are L2J High Five datapack values (Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack main). L2Toggle may differ; nothing here was checked live.

fort.sql castleId is 0 for every fort (it is the CONTRACTED castle, set at runtime). "castle"/"castles" come from the Special Envoys in fort_spawnlist (spawnType 3, castleId column) — the castles the fort can contract with. Border forts (2-3 envoy castles) have castle = null.
type: territory = envoy of 1 castle, border = envoys of 2+ castles (Fort.isBorderFortress). size: fort.sql fortType 0 = small (3 commanders), 1 = large (4 commanders + control room).

commanders = siege-time L2FortCommander NPCs from FortSiege.properties (order 1 Archer, 2 Guard, 3 Support, 4 General standing in for the Main Machine). The peaceful captains in fort_spawnlist (spawnType 1) stand on the same spots; barracksPeaceNpcId links them.
Combat flag item 9819 "Combat flag" (FortSiegeManager.isCombat: itemId == 9819). Each fort has 3 flag spawns inside the command building; carry one to the flag pole to take the fort.
flagPole is a static object (staticObjects.xml type 3), not an NPC: npcId is null, staticObjectId given. Its z is the top of the pole.

Door roles derived from doors.xml hp_showable: shown = outer gate; hidden = main building/barracks doors which FortSiege opens after all commanders die. Fort doors are named fortress_<map tile>_NNN; tile = first 4 digits of the flag pole static id.

npc role values used: manager (Foreman = L2FortManager), logistics, suspicious_merchant (siege registration, spawnType 2), envoy (castle Special Envoy, spawnType 3), doorman, dungeon_warden, wyvern_manager, captain (peace-time commander NPC). No fort gatekeeper NPC exists in this datapack (owner teleports are listed in ownerTeleports from teleports_h5.json).
nearestLanding = nearest public town-gatekeeper destination from gatekeepers_h5.json (datapack); castle/fort owner teleports are excluded there and listed separately.
Residential skills come from pledgeSkillTree.xml (residenceSkill="true", residenceId = fort id); given to every clan member while the clan owns the fort; clanLevelRequired = getLevel.
